sections.title: Three generations of *independent agents*
body: Conveniently located on the Southside of Aiken, Lambert Insurance was founded in January 2001 by Diana M. Lambert, a third-generation independent insurance agent. Her roots go back to Woonsocket, Rhode Island, where she received her professional training working for her parents, Raymond and Claire Levesque, at Levesque Insurance Agency.
Diana Lambert was awarded Best Insurance Agent for 2018 by Aiken's Choice. The agency prides itself on good, old-fashioned and courteous service.
